editorial: Feel your heart pummel as the spotlight burns a little hotter when a once‑legendary star is offered a hero gig to keep his pension afloat. You’re drawn into a chaotic blend of high‑octane action and self‑referential wit that has Cage channeling everyone from the giddy assassin to the brooding angel in quick, punchy flashes. The standout moment comes when his manic charisma turns a tense shoot‑out into a slapstick spectacle that still feels fresh and intentional. The film balances frenetic pacing with a few more deliberately drawn‑out scenes that risk dragging the momentum. You’ll appreciate it most if you enjoy a tongue‑in‑cheek take on blockbuster formulae.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of action‑comedy who enjoy meta humor and pop‑culture references.
